name: FERPA
description: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act — U.S. federal law that protects the privacy of student education records. Applies to all schools that receive federal funding.

controls.title: Annual Notification
controls.description: Schools must annually notify students and parents of their FERPA rights, including the right to inspect and review education records.

controls.title: Right to Inspect and Review
controls.description: Students and parents have the right to inspect and review the student's education records within 45 days of the request.

controls.title: Right to Request Amendment
controls.description: Students and parents have the right to request amendment of education records they believe to be inaccurate, misleading, or otherwise violate the student's privacy rights.

controls.title: Right to Consent to Disclosures
controls.description: Schools must have written consent from eligible students or parents before disclosing education records, with limited exceptions.

controls.title: Directory Information
controls.description: Schools may disclose directory information without consent if they have notified students and parents and provided an opportunity to opt-out.

controls.title: Legitimate Educational Interest
controls.description: Schools may disclose education records to school officials with legitimate educational interest. The school must use reasonable methods to ensure appropriate access.

controls.title: Third Party Disclosures
controls.description: When disclosing records to a third party, schools must make a reasonable attempt to provide notice to the student/parent and obtain consent unless an exception applies.

controls.title: Data Breach Response
controls.description: Schools must respond to unauthorized disclosures of education records and assess the impact on student privacy. Notification procedures should be established.

controls.title: Access Controls
controls.description: Schools must implement reasonable methods to ensure that only school officials with legitimate educational interest access education records.

controls.title: Record Keeping of Disclosures
controls.description: Schools must maintain a record of all parties that have requested or obtained access to a student's education records, and the legitimate interest of each party.
